saltus, saltūs m.

noun, fourth declension

a narrow pass, a defile through mountains or woods

The same word as saltus “wooded upland”; “a jump” is a different word, saltus from saliō.

Other words

  • angustiae, angustiārum f. pl. — narrows, a narrow passage

    noun, first declension, plural · also used · classical · Caes. BC 3.49 (Lewis & Short s.v. angustia)

See also ridge, gorge.
